C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. A policy term that was not read cannot be compared, kept or enforced, so it is refused where it enters (ADR 0009, amended 2026-11-18). A catalog offer may not name an assigner or an assignee (prepare_dataset, catalog.rs).
